description: This PHP file defines the MailerSubscriber class, which subscribes to the Symfony kernel terminate event. When triggered, it checks a cache key 'core.send_email', and if set, it initiates sending all pending emails via the EmailQueueService, logging the process duration and updating the cache accordingly.
external_methods: OrangeHRM/Core/Traits	raits used in this class (LoggerTrait, AuthUserTrait, EntityManagerHelperTrait)

classes.name: MailerSubscriber
classes.description: A Symfony event subscriber that listens for the kernel terminate event to trigger email sending operations based on a cache key.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns the events this subscriber listens to, specifically the kernel terminate event.

methods.name: onTerminateEvent
methods.description: Handles the terminate event, checks the cache, and if conditions are met, sends all pending emails and logs execution details.
